search_verification.method: Fresh complete identity enumeration of public authored upstream merged PRs using four disjoint creation-date ranges, each below the 1,000-result cap. All 21 pages were collected; totals stayed stable across each partition. The 1,793 search identities plus three individually rechecked known search omissions yield 1,796 accessible merged PRs. Every one of the 65 new identities was individually checked via its pull-request endpoint for Afloat16 authorship, actual merged state and merge SHA. Four historical unavailable ONNX Runtime identities are retained.
search_verification.search_merge_sha_note: Search responses contain merged timestamps but not merge SHAs. Fresh direct checks include the merge SHA. Older unchanged SHA provenance remains in the pinned baseline receipts.

representative_selection_additions.name: PyTorch Lightning

selected_prs.title: Preserve training weights in final WeightAveraging checkpoints
selected_prs.author: Afloat16
selected_prs.production_summary: on_train_end swaps the averaged model into the live model and retains the non-averaged training weights in the existing averaging container. A role flag controls checkpoint serialization and validation swapping; loading resets the flag. Final checkpoints retain the training weights separately from the averaged inference weights without introducing another persistent model copy.
selected_prs.committed_regression_summary: Committed regressions distinguish exact SWA/EMA training and averaged weights and buffers in epoch/final/manual checkpoints; compare resumed and uninterrupted Trainer runs, including momentum buffers; preserve post-fit validation averages; and reload into the same callback.

selected_prs.title: Honor per-loader limits during combined iteration
selected_prs.author: Afloat16
selected_prs.production_summary: The min_size and max_size iterators stop or skip inputs at their configured per-loader limits. max_size_cycle tracks each input's consumed count, resets it when restarting that input, and applies the same limit during the restart. Existing handling for genuinely empty inputs is retained.
selected_prs.committed_regression_summary: Committed regressions compare all iteration modes with independent truncated-sequence references, bound infinite iterable loaders, cover zero and infinite limits, reset/reiteration and pickling, and compare consumed batches plus final SGD parameters in real CPU Trainer runs with fractional limits.

representative_selection_additions.engineering_en: Preserve training weights separately from final averaged weights in checkpoints, and enforce per-loader batch limits during combined iteration so resume restores matching weights and cycling uses only allowed batches.
representative_selection_additions.engineering_zh: 在检查点中分别保留训练权重与最终平均权重，并在组合迭代中执行各加载器的批次上限，让恢复训练使用匹配的权重、循环采样只覆盖允许的批次。

all_reviewed_prs.title: Preserve unrelated mask buffers in pruning checkpoints
all_reviewed_prs.author: Afloat16
all_reviewed_prs.production_summary: Pruning checkpoint export identifies actual reparameterizations through BasePruningMethod pre-hooks instead of treating all _mask buffer names as pruning. named_modules(remove_duplicate=False) retains shared-module aliases, and the mapping also covers parameters on the root module.
all_reviewed_prs.committed_regression_summary: Committed regressions use native PyTorch prune.remove as an independent export reference, cover unrelated paired buffers, shared modules and root parameters, run save/load/resume with MultiheadAttention, and compare the next momentum-SGD update with and without export.

representative_selection_additions.selection_reason: Select final averaging checkpoint semantics and per-loader iteration limits as the two complementary training-correctness changes. The pruning-buffer fix was also reviewed and is genuine merged work, but is not added as a third example to keep the existing row density.
limitations: No GPU, distributed, or full-repository validation was run in this refresh.
PR-description test counts were not promoted into a fresh test-pass claim.
These fixes preserve specific checkpoint and loader semantics; no model-quality, throughput, or general reliability benchmark is claimed.
